intro: Convert Files is a free file converter that runs entirely in your browser. There is no server doing the work, no upload, no queue and no account — the page you are looking at is the whole product.

Most online converters send your file to a machine you will never see, convert it there and keep a copy for a while. This one does the opposite: it brings the converter to you. Images are decoded and re-encoded by your browser’s own engines, documents are rebuilt from their structure, audio and video are re-encoded with the codecs already inside Chrome, and every result is written straight to your disk.
That design is the reason it can be free and public. Nothing is stored, nothing is metered, and there is no cost that has to be recovered from you.
points: Free, with no limits on how many files you convert
No sign-in, sign-up, email or payment details — ever
Your file never leaves your device
Works on Mac, Windows, Linux, iPad and Android in a modern browser
Honest about what it cannot do: every pair offered is one that actually works
